specs.title: 13.4 native partition: atomic count/byte eviction, two writers, faults, corruption and clear barrier
13.4 native DB2 migration preserves the eleven old projections; damaged known meta is clearable and future meta is untouched
13.4 real editor: code history survives refresh, invalid drafts stay exact, old Rust runs clear and current locks still apply
13.4 native block value/add/delete and drag endpoints restore exact canvas and remain usable at three widths
13.4 production save failure stays visible, explicit retry preserves IDs and clear removes history across tabs
invalid display/avatar rows stay in native IDB while valid learning remains visible; confirmed local reset preserves every unrelated row
invalid progress and receipts are isolated without erasure and pause learning writes
an invalid ledger marks total points uncertain and cannot be converted into an empty or repaired reward history
known eleven-store archives with invalid or missing meta can be explicitly cleared into a fresh generation
unknown semantic and future physical versions refuse this client clear and preserve every native row
native quota and permission API faults leave provisional learning unsaved and retry the original command without extra rights
a new-day goal-open failure retries the original trusted occurrence without inventing a goal version or changing the date
an unavailable open permits clearly temporary learning without rebinding its facts when storage returns
aborting after native learning writes and after clear writes preserves the entire previous eleven-store archive
two actual same-origin pages merge same and different synthetic facts without dropped rows or duplicate first rewards
clear invalidates an in-flight command and queued local settings immediately, then prevents every old operation from restoring data
a peer that misses every notification still rejects its pre-clear command instead of rebinding it to the new generation
real production BroadcastChannel updates a peer without focus refresh and discards its old draft after another page clears

specs.title: production home visibly marks a corrupt ledger total as unconfirmed instead of displaying zero points
production singleton reset requires its own confirmation and leaves all unrelated stored settings and learning rows unchanged
actual isolated browser contexts keep native IDB through refresh and discard that isolated profile when the context closes
new native IndexedDB has twelve out-of-line stores, one saved default set and a nondestructive availability probe
synthetic receipt and unique reward survive refresh and closing/reopening a page without producing new facts
same receipt retries return the original revision and different IDs cannot duplicate the stable reward key
reusing an event ID with changed subject version, learning revision, occurrence time or goal version is rejected without changes
a real transaction aborted after a successful receipt request rolls back all stores and reports unsaved, then exact retry succeeds
injected quota and storage-disabled API faults are unsaved and never erase existing data
writing with a stale generation fails even without an invalidation notification
unknown semantic versions, invalid meta and missing meta preserve the native archive instead of reinitializing it
versionchange closes the current connection, and future physical versions remain intact and reject the old client
a queued native open can be cancelled while another connection blocks deletion, and late open does not leak a connection
frozen synthetic reference 0.9 migrates atomically to SAVE1 without inventing day facts, receipts or completion rewards
interrupting reference migration after a native row request succeeds preserves every original row and supports controlled retry
invalid reference predecessors reject without rewriting the original native rows
